en.topic_title: Hong Kong’s urban renewal body to set up HK$100 million ‘AI-first’ tender assessment subsidiary
en.topic_summary:
Hong Kong’s urban redevelopment body will spend no more than HK$100 million to set up a subsidiary that will verify tender applications using automated AI systems, in response to accusations of corruption in the wake of the deadly Tai Po fire.



Wang Fuk Court on May 4, 2026. Photo: Kyle Lam/HKFP.
